Q1. If all the repeated numbers in Step IV are removed, then what is the average of second number
from the left end and fifth number from the right end?
questions.explanation: After repeated Step IV values are removed, the sequence is 30, 28, 04, 24, 08, 48, 12, 06. The second is 28 and fifth from the right is 24; their average is 26.
questions.source: INPUT OUTPUT MAINS SETS by Arpit sir.pdf, physical PDF page 3, Q1
